entities.name: CysA sulfate transporter ATPase
observations: 264 aa bacterial ABC transporter nucleotide-binding subunit; exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q93DX8.
Contains the Walker A/P-loop sequence GPSGCGKTT at residues approximately 31–41 and a Pfam ABC_tran domain spanning residues 18–164.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is 29,137.946 Da and theoretical pI is 6.318.
Curated homolog annotation assigns sulfate/thiosulfate import energy-coupling activity in the CysAWTP complex.
Annotated as a peripheral component associated with the inner membrane transporter complex, not as a transmembrane protein itself.
The transporter complex contains two CysA ATP-binding subunits, two membrane proteins CysT/CysW, and the solute-binding protein CysP.

entities.name: Sulfate import ATP hydrolysis
observations: Rhea-mapped candidate reaction: sulfate(out) + ATP + H2O = sulfate(in) + ADP + phosphate + H(+).
The ATPase hydrolyzes ATP to drive sulfate uptake; substrate specificity is supported by exact curated homolog annotation.

entities.name: Thiosulfate import ATP hydrolysis
observations: Rhea-mapped candidate reaction: thiosulfate(out) + ATP + H2O = thiosulfate(in) + ADP + phosphate + H(+).
Thiosulfate transport is included in the curated CysA homolog annotation.

entities.name: CysAWTP sulfate transporter
observations: ABC transporter complex for sulfate/thiosulfate import; CysA provides ATP-driven energy coupling.
